name: high_water
description: README and site: a whole High Water match on Wickhollow, played out. I am the Lamplighter, played by the plan bot (tests/bot.gd); the second seat, named Ana, is a Lookout the caretaker plays from her plan. Wave 10 (Duskmoths and Gourdlings) is shot with the match held (ticks per frame 0) once the wave's banner has gone: Duskmoths fly along the road by the pond, two of them wearing the Owl's Eye's mark and one selected, towards Ana's forked Hawk Roosts and Perch Ballistas; the Gourdlings follow from the Welling, and my Longbow Lofts, Great Cannon and Frost Spire stand along the bottom. While the match is held the strip shows Ana's seat as present rather than caretaker (her seat's state is set back before the match goes on), as a party's would. The same moment at 1200 x 630 is the social card. Then the match plays out to the results.

steps.msg: the caretaker plays the Lookout's seat
